origin.description: Returns information about the available palettes as a dataframe.
origin.details: brewer.pal.info is not a function, it is a variable. The table lists each palette name with its maximum color count, category (div, qual, or seq), and whether ColorBrewer marks it as colorblind friendly.
origin.value: A data frame with columns maxcolors, category, and colorblind and row names equal to the palette names.

translation.description: Returns information about the available palettes as a table object.
translation.details: The row order and values follow the brewer.pal.info data.frame built in R/ColorBrewer.R. Row selection with a missing name returns NA fields, matching R subsetting.
translation.value: A BrewerPalInfo instance with maxcolors, category, and colorblind columns and palette names as row keys.
translation.example:
from RColorBrewer.brewer import brewer_pal_info, format_brewer_pal_info
print(format_brewer_pal_info(brewer_pal_info), end="")
print(format_brewer_pal_info_row(brewer_pal_info, "Blues"), end="")
print(brewer_pal_info["Blues"].maxcolors)
